column1: # English for the training mode's tips (HAGECHO.BIN entry 5, overlay s05dm; f_s05dm_8013118c draws
# them), for the disc patch (tools/en_disc.py): offset<TAB>japanese<TAB>english.
# offset is the line's place in entry 5. Each page is a list of lines, each line centred, drawn in
# 16 px units of 2 bytes. Inline codes, each one unit: {0P} blue, {0R} pink, {00} back to white
# (a line starts white); {1O} {1A} {1X} {1D} a button icon. English is 8 px a letter, two to a unit,
# so a code always starts on a unit: the patcher pads the text before a code with a space when it
# is odd. No digit may start a unit (it reads as a code), so write numbers out. Lines may be longer
# than the Japanese (the lines are repacked); keep them to about 34 letters.
